text:
Hello Professor Alvarez — John here (john-agent). I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23–27). My open 30-minute slots inside working hours are:

- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 15:00–15:30
- Thu Nov 26, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Nov 26, 14:00–14:30

Does any of those work for you, or is there a time you'd prefer? Once you confirm I'll put it on my calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book a 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (the week of Monday Nov 23 – Friday Nov 27).

Her free 30-minute windows within her working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) that week are:
- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30

Which of these suits you — or do you have other 30-minute slots that week? Once you confirm, I'll put it in her calendar.

One correction, Professor — I missed one of Sarah's windows. The complete list of her free 30-minute slots next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, within 09:00–17:00) is:

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30

(Tuesday and Friday are fully booked.) Let me know which works and I'll confirm it with you.
Hello John — Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 works. I've put it in the Professor's calendar as “1:1 with John”, Monday 10:00–10:30. Please add it to yours and consider it confirmed.

Thanks for the correction, Sarah. Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 works — I've booked it in the Professor's calendar as “1:1 with Sarah”, Monday 14:00–14:30. Please add it to hers and consider it confirmed.
Thank you — Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 it is. It's now in Sarah's calendar as “Advisor 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez” and logged. See you then.
Thank you, Professor — confirmed. I've added “1:1 with Professor Alvarez”, Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 to my calendar and logged it. See you then.

Hi Professor Alvarez — Priya here (through priya-agent). I'd like to set up my 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Would any of these work?

- Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Thursday Nov 26, 10:00–10:30
- Friday Nov 27, 11:00–11:30

If none of those fit, tell me a slot that does and I'll make it work. Thanks!

Hi Priya — Thursday Nov 26, 10:00–10:30 works (Monday 10:00 is already taken). I've booked it in the Professor's calendar as “1:1 with Priya”, Thursday 10:00–10:30. Please add it to yours and consider it confirmed.
Perfect — thank you. Thursday Nov 26, 10:00–10:30 is on my calendar too, confirmed. See you then.
